class.name: ResonanceRuntimeBaker
class.brief_description: Runtime helper to bake probe volumes into RAM (proc-gen, exported games, no editor UI).
class.description: GDScript [code]class_name[/code] over headless [code]ResonanceBakeRunner[/code]. Bakes acoustic probe data into memory only ([code]save_results[/code] false; no ResourceSaver / EditorInterface). Use for procedural levels or play-mode rebakes without disk write. When merged static geometry also changes at runtime, prefer [url=#ResonanceRuntimeExporter]ResonanceRuntimeExporter[/url] (optional [code]bake_probes[/code] uses this baker).

method.name: bake_volumes_to_ram
method.description: Bakes [param volumes] ([ResonanceProbeVolume]) under [param scene_root] into RAM. Emits [signal bake_progress_updated] then [signal bake_finished]. Errors and returns early (still emits finished) when volumes or scene_root are missing.

method.name: flush_volumes
method.description: Calls [method ResonanceProbeVolume.release_probe_batch] on each volume. Leaves [member ResonanceProbeVolume.probe_data] unchanged; skips volumes without the method.

method.name: flush_all_runtime_bakes
method.description: Flushes every [ResonanceProbeVolume] under [param scene_root] (teardown / before re-bake).

method.name: reload_volumes
method.description: Calls [method ResonanceProbeVolume.reload_probe_batch] where present (after flush or RAM probe updates).

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Shuts down the internal bake runner and clears it. Call when finished with this baker instance.

signal.name: bake_progress_updated
signal.description: Progress text from the bake runner (e.g. loading screens).

signal.name: bake_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a bake run completes or when [method bake_volumes_to_ram] aborts early.
